Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de informații
📣 Would you like to join a company that puts people at the heart of its concerns? We are waiting for you! Since 2007, Extia, an IT consulting company, has been offering a unique approach in its field by combining well-being at work and performance.
 Our philosophy at Extia is “First who, then what", so let's go for it!
 🚀First who?
You are an Agile team player with excellent communication skills
You handle requests and incidents promptly with rigor and discipline
You have a collaborative mindset, ready to work seamlessly with cross-functional teams to integrate changes and ensure compliance
 This role is flexible hybrid, around 5 days/MONTH from the office in Bucharest.
 🚀Then what?
 Azure Cloud Engineer providing operational support for cloud environments, with the following tasks:
Handle and resolve change requests and incidents related to Azure resources, ensuring adherence to best practices and service level agreements
Manage and administer Azure cloud services (VM, Storage Account, permissions, Gateways, etc.), ensuring their availability, performance, and security
Support teams in maintaining, automating, and optimizing Azure infrastructures to ensure environment stability, security, and performance
Collaborate with DevOps, security, and development teams to integrate changes into operational processes
Contribute to the continuous improvement of support procedures, monitoring, and documentation for Azure infrastructures
 Required technical skills and qualifications:
Engineering degree or equivalent in computer science, systems, cloud, or relevant professional experience
Proven experience in support and administration of Azure environments
Strong knowledge of Azure services including VMs, AKS, networking, storage, and security
Understanding of DevOps practices and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or equivalent is a plus)
 🚀 Do you recognize yourself in the "Who" and represent the "What"? Apply and let's talk!
